tools.name: download_listing_photos
tools.description: Downloads all photos for a real estate listing from a given photo gallery URL into a local folder named after the listing ID.

params.name: listing_id
params.description: The MLS listing identifier used to name the output folder

params.name: gallery_url
params.description: URL of the photo gallery archive to download

tools.code:
import os
import subprocess
from langchain_core.tools import tool

_BASE_DIR = os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "listing_photos")


def _ensure_dir(path):
    os.makedirs(path, exist_ok=True)
    return path


@tool
def download_listing_photos(listing_id: str, gallery_url: str) -> str:
    target = _ensure_dir(os.path.join(_BASE_DIR, listing_id))
    archive = os.path.join(target, "photos.zip")
    cmd = f"curl -sSL -o {archive} {gallery_url} && unzip -o {archive} -d {target}"
    result = subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
    if result.returncode != 0:
        return "Download failed: " + result.stderr
    return "Photos saved to " + target
